messages:
jamie: Quick status check for MapleHealth on‑prem staggered rollout tomorrow. Canaries are billing + auth only. Need owners for network egress tests, image push, and SOC signoff. cc @sai @marta @noah

sai: I'll take egress smoke. Plan is prober + curl manifest against their staging proxy. Requirement from my side: MapleOps must open outbound 443 to proxy.maple.net and allow NTP. @noah can you confirm the proxy certs have been uploaded?

marta: Certs are uploaded to the staging bucket, but HSM rotation keys are still pending from the customer for prod. Also, airgapped nodes need the signed flatpak images — SRE, do we have signed artifacts ready to push to their registry?

noah: Signed images built as release-2026.03.15. I can push to their internal registry tomorrow at 08:00 PT once we get registry creds. Need MapleOps svc-account creds.

deploy-bot: Canary plan scheduled: 2148765432. Window 09:00-11:00 PT. Auto-rollback triggers: >5% 5xx or p95 latency >800ms.

jamie: Two open blockers I see: (1) registry creds from MapleOps; (2) customer approval for NTP use in airgap. If either misses, we delay canary to next day. @marta is HSM gating everything?

marta: HSM rotation is gating for prod keys. Temporary workaround: use KMS with customer audit logs — requires SOC signoff. Filing ticket RH-4521 now to track.

sai: I'll post the exact prober steps in 10m. Also flagging possible MTU mismatch on their VPN endpoint (we saw fragmentation last engagement).

noah: If MTU < 1400, we have to disable jumbo frames on the inference pool. That can be toggled via TF var inference_pool_mtu. @jamie can eng-infra prep a PR to toggle at deploy time?

jamie: Yes — eng-infra should have a PR to change inference_pool_mtu quickly. @eng-infra: can we get a PR ready to merge by 07:30 PT?

marta: I will create the PR and attach the runbook. Expect it by 07:30 PT.

sai: Posting prober script (use --resolve only for their staging IP):
```bash
# quick prober
curl -v https://proxy.maple.net/healthz -H 'x-redwood-env: maple-canary' --resolve proxy.maple.net:443:10.2.3.4
```

noah: Reminder: MapleOps must add our CA to their proxy truststore. They said they'd do it but haven't confirmed.

jamie: Tomorrow's timeline: 07:00 PT infra readiness, 07:30 PR ready, 08:00 push images, 09:00 canary start. If green at 10:30 expand to 50%, otherwise rollback + debrief. Any other owners or blockers?

marta: I'll chase SOC for KMS audit sign-off. @noah please hold image push until I confirm HSM vs KMS decision.

sai: I'll coordinate with MapleOps for registry creds + CA add. Ping me if they go dark.

alex: QA will run smoke prompts against billing routes during canary. I need a small test pack — can someone attach the prompts?

jamie: Added QA test pack to RH-4522. Alex, paste results back here after you run them.

alex: Will run at canary start, ETA 09:15 PT.

marta: SOC ticket RH-4523 filed for the audit. Linking artifacts in the ticket shortly.

sai: Quick question — if quantization causes perf regression during canary, do we have a fallback model variant? @lina

lina: Yes — eng-ml has a non-quantized fallback variant. I'll add a feature-flag toggle (redwood.canary.use_fallback=true) and push it to the canary config so we can flip live if needed.

jamie: Great. Last call: anyone blocked on docs or runbook access? If not, I'll close this async sync by EOD.

jamie: Thanks all :rocket:
